dimensions.name: Verification readiness
dimensions.question: Can the repository automatically prove a scoped change is correct?
dimensions.probe: From a clean checkout, restore, build, test, make a scoped change, and run the same gates.

dimensions.name: Repository understandability
dimensions.question: Can an agent locate ownership, dependencies, and validation without guessing?
dimensions.probe: Locate the owning code and instructions, explain impact, and identify the correct checks before editing.

dimensions.name: Automation readiness
dimensions.question: Can the documented workflow run without undocumented manual steps?
dimensions.probe: Run the CI-equivalent workflow from documented commands on a clean environment.

dimensions.name: Agent operability
dimensions.question: Can an agent diagnose failures, retry safely, and leave reviewable evidence?
dimensions.probe: Complete a representative task, recover from one induced failure, and produce a reviewable handoff.

dimensions.name: Outcome effectiveness
dimensions.question: Does agent use improve speed without reducing quality?
dimensions.probe: Compare representative tasks with a baseline using paired speed and quality measures.
